title: Stop-on-K successes with conditioned stop cause
text: A box has 17 red and 4 black cards. Cards are drawn without replacement until either 5 reds appear or 19 total draws are made, whichever happens first. You are told the process ended because 5 reds appeared (not because the draw limit was hit). What is the probability that exactly 7 draws were needed?
